answer: What player on this terrace would trade one true face for ten painted masks? Weight here is counted in shale: stake multiplied by the square of the layers beneath it. One sparrow with ten seasons of shale behind a stake of ten weighs a thousand; ten fresh masks, each a stake of one on a single layer, weigh ten between them. Split the purse and the weight crumbles. One true sparrow outweighs ten painted masks.
